posts.title: Our family is growing: meet DropBot v4.0
posts.summary: The next generation of DropBot: one benchtop instrument that makes low-volume automation accessible in any lab.
posts.summary_html:
The next generation of DropBot, first shown at SLAS 2026: one benchtop instrument that makes low-volume automation accessible in any lab.

  • Automated sample prep from nL to µL
  • 120 individually addressable electrodes, 35–200 Vrms, 50 Hz – 65 kHz
  • Built-in magnet and heater for bead-based and thermal workflows
  • Brightfield and fluorescence camera with exchangeable filters
  • Touchscreen and embedded computer, so it runs stand-alone
  • Optional: PMT for ultra-sensitive detection, battery operation
